children.text:
<accent>fictty read note/standup</>
<accent>fictty put draft -</> <d><<< '"from an agent"'</>
<accent>fictty theme paper</>
<accent>fictty get --state</>

Writes take <b>--if-rev N</>: if anyone wrote since
revision N, the write is refused, with what's there.
<d>The store outlives every screen: the notes, the ledger and your drafts are all here, by revision and by who wrote them last.</>
